notes: 2026-11-10 first Egypt run. Not found: no official duty (rota) list and no animal poison line (Egypt Poison Control Center Cairo University serves people; no page opened stating animals). Blocked by robots, skipped: vet.cu.edu.eg (Cairo University teaching hospital), animalplanet.clinic, petmedicclinic.com, drpawss.com (second Dr Paws site). Not opened/not fetchable: evma.org, Egyptian Veterinary Syndicate site, GOVS site (no URL found by search); Facebook-only clinics (Smart Vet Clinic, Veterinary Care Center Hurghada, Jungle Veterinary clinic, Dr Amira Nabil Sinai vet center, Aleefy Veterinary Hospital, Alexandria Pet Center Smouha, Smouha Pets Center) skipped because Facebook is not an own site that could be opened. Directory-only leads NOT used (no own site opened): Nabd Alif Zayed hospital (24 h, Sheikh Zayed), Pet Care Hospital Dr Ahmed Ramadan (24 h, 6th October), Catdog Hospital, Pets Planet Clinic, Benji, Vetology, Best 4 Pets, Fardous Pets, Pets Home, Sharm Vet Clinic and Sinai Vet Clinic (Umm El Sid, Sharm), B-Vet (Sharm), Top Vets Hurghada, Stanley Veterinary Clinic (Alexandria), Pet Cure (Maadi), Scout Vet (Nasr City), Alex Vet Clinic. Left: Alexandria (no own-site clinic found), Sharm El-Sheikh (none), Dahab (clinic exists, no contact data on opened page), Aswan (none), Luxor private clinics, Hurghada/El Gouna others, Giza Dokki/Mohandessin/Haram, Nasr City, Heliopolis, Cairo University, Alexandria University, other university hospitals (Mansoura, Benha, Zagazig, Kafr El-Sheikh), GOVS/syndicate duty arrangements.
